findings.issue: The app ships no tests and no test infrastructure whatsoever; every data-layer behaviour is guarded only by the external acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight runner (vitest) and unit tests for the pure modules in app/app/lib/ and the loaders' transformation logic before the next refactor touches them.

findings.issue: getIndex() assembles the whole filtering index — species sorted by ID, per-Pokémon type slots gathered from 18 type records and slot-sorted, generation species sets — with no coverage; a slot-order or dedupe regression changes every filtered list and card.
findings.suggestion: Test index assembly against small fixture API payloads: assert slot ordering, exclusion of stellar/unknown/shadow types, and that a Pokémon absent from the species list is dropped.

findings.issue: Filter matching, pagination slicing, page clamping (NaN/negative/over-range page) and default-param omission are the app's core URL-state logic and are untested; an off-by-one in `slice((page-1)*48, page*48)` or the Math.max/Math.min clamp would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Extract the loader's filter/page math into a pure function and test edge cases: page=0, page=9999, page=abc, 0 matches, last-page boundary, and query-param omission for defaults.

findings.issue: The sort comparator mixes numbers and strings via String(a).localeCompare and handles nulls-last in both directions — subtle invariants (null beats nothing in either direction, tie-break by move label, aria-sort cleared on unsorted headers) are untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator and the toggle state: ascending then descending on each column, null values staying last both ways, and aria-sort on exactly one header.

findings.issue: Default game selection (highest order), method ordering (level-up/machine/egg/tutor then alphabetical) and the level-up level-then-name sort are spec-mandated orderings with no coverage; methodRank in pokemon.tsx:54-57 is easy to break silently.
findings.suggestion: Feed a small fixture loader with two version groups and four methods, and assert table order, default game, and that `?game=` overrides it.

findings.issue: pokemonCards implements alternate-form exclusion (id >= 10000), dedupe and dex-number sorting for every cross-reference list (moves, abilities, types); the redundant >= 10000 check would mask a speciesCard refactor that stops returning null for unknown IDs.
findings.suggestion: Test with refs including a Mega form (id 10033), a duplicate, and out-of-order IDs; assert counts and ordering.

findings.issue: Client-side filter wiring (150 ms debounce, replace-vs-push navigation, and two effects that sync uncontrolled inputs to the URL without clobbering typing, including the pre-hydration workaround at home.tsx:96-104) is hand-rolled interaction logic that no test would catch breaking.
findings.suggestion: Add a component test that types in the search box, asserts one debounced URL update, and simulates back/forward preserving input state.

findings.issue: humanize, idFromUrl, latestFlavorText and orMissing underpin every page; e.g. orMissing treats 0 as present (correct) but '' as missing, and latestFlavorText assumes array order encodes recency — all untested one-liners with blast radius.
findings.suggestion: A five-minute unit test file over format.ts would lock down these invariants cheaply.

findings.issue: Effect text substitution (`$effect_chance` → number, or empty string when null) has a silent failure mode: a move with null effect_chance renders the effect with the placeholder deleted, and the fallback chain short_effect → flavor → em dash is untested.
findings.suggestion: Test the effect-resolution chain with three fixture moves: one with short_effect, one with only flavor text, one with neither.

findings.issue: The RELATIONS mapping (six damage-relation keys in a spec-mandated order, each rendering 'None' when empty) and the 18-type validation guard at type.tsx:26 are untested.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot-free assertion over the six dl terms and their order against a fixture type record.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no test script, no fixtures — so all quality gates come from the external acceptance suite. The untested surface is precisely the riskiest code: cross-endpoint index assembly, filtering and pagination math, URL-state synchronization, and multi-column sorting with nulls-last semantics. Once the acceptance suite stops being the only guard, a refactor of app/app/lib/api.server.ts or the home loader could break every list page without a failing check.

untested.area: Index assembly in getIndex (app/app/lib/api.server.ts:74-125): type-slot gathering and ordering, generation sets, species sorting
untested.likelyBug: A slot-ordering or dedupe regression would show wrong types on every home-page card and mis-filter the type dropdown silently.
Off-by-one in the 48-per-page slice or a broken page clamp (page=0, page=NaN, page beyond total) showing empty or duplicated pages; default params reappearing in URLs.
Nulls sorting first on descending, string-vs-number comparison inversion, or aria-sort persisting on unsorted headers after switching columns.

untested.area: Pokémon loader move tables (app/app/routes/pokemon.tsx:108-137): default game, method order, level-up sort
untested.likelyBug: Wrong default game after a reorder, or machine/egg/tutor tables appearing in alphabetical instead of spec order without failing any check.
Alternate forms leaking into 'Learned by'/'Pokémon' lists and counts if the >= 10000 guard or speciesCard null-return is changed independently.

untested.area: Client filter interaction: debounce, replace-vs-push, input/URL sync (app/app/routes/home.tsx:67-110)
untested.likelyBug: Typing being clobbered by the sync effect, debounce timer leaking on unmount, or back/forward losing filter state.
A refactor caching rejected promises would serve stale errors for up to 60 s, or break the delete-on-catch eviction, and nothing would fail until production flakiness.

untested.area: Formatting helpers (app/app/lib/format.ts:8-41): humanize, idFromUrl, latestFlavorText, orMissing
untested.likelyBug: idFromUrl returning NaN for a changed URL shape, or latestFlavorText picking the first instead of last English entry — every page's names, numbers and descriptions shift.
Moves with null effect_chance rendering sentences with a missing number, or the flavor-text fallback being skipped.

untested.area: 404 and not-found paths (apiOr404 in app/app/lib/api.server.ts:35-40, type validation in app/app/routes/type.tsx:26)
untested.likelyBug: An unknown Pokémon name or a non-battle type (e.g. /types/shadow) throwing a 500 instead of rendering the not-found route.
